# Labeled evaluation fixtures

Store reviewed, redistributable benchmark cases here. Each future fixture must
identify its source, license, question, context, gold atomic claims, and grading
rule. Do not commit model credentials, proprietary prompts, or unreviewed market
data.

Fixtures authored specifically for this repository are covered by the root
Apache License 2.0. Imported or adapted fixtures retain their source licensing
and must be compatible with redistribution in this repository; record those
terms with each fixture rather than assuming the root license applies.

The scaffold intentionally contains no synthetic "gold" cases: calibration is
meaningful only when labels and grading policy have been reviewed.
